source.question: Why is naive cosine search over raw chunks insufficient for cross-repo code retrieval?
options: Vector indexes cannot store payloads larger than 1KB
Cosine similarity is undefined on code embeddings
Embedding models do not see code as tokens
It poisons results on generated code, monorepo duplication, and rarely imported symbols

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：向量搜索可能漏精确符号并受重复/生成副本影响；并非所有纯向量查询必失败，是否需图/混合应实测。

source.question: What does AST-aware chunking mean in the ingestion pipeline?
options: Splitting code into fixed 256-token windows
Compressing chunks with gzip before storage
Cutting at tree-sitter node boundaries such as function and class spans
Dropping comments and whitespace before embedding

quiz.reference_answer: 选3（index2）：AST节点span切分保留函数类结构，超长函数/配置/解析失败另有回退；并非固定token永远不允许。

source.question: Which three retrievable modalities does each chunk get in this pipeline?
options: Raw text, gzip, and hash
Token IDs, syntax tree, and call graph
AST, IR, and bytecode
Dense embedding, BM25 terms, and a natural-language summary

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：dense、sparse词项、自然语言摘要是蓝图表征，summary仍需标为派生/可失真且不替原文。

source.question: What is the role of the cross-encoder reranker after the hybrid retrieval step?
options: It scores each query-candidate pair together for higher accuracy than cosine alone
It rewrites the chunks to remove generated code
It re-embeds the query in a different model
It compresses the chunks before sending to the synthesizer

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）：联合query-candidate重排细交互，不能恢复未召回证据；原TS未实现cross encoder。

source.question: Why does the synthesizer reject answers without (repo/path:start-end) anchors?
options: Citation faithfulness gates the answer so users can verify each claim
Anchors are required by the vector database schema
Anchors reduce token cost on the synthesis call
Anchors are needed for downstream BM25 reranking

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）：锚点便于回查，但解析到anchor不自动证明faithfulness，必须核逐主张支持、版本与权限。

source.question: What does incremental re-index require to stay under 60 seconds on a 50-file push?
options: Dropping the symbol graph entirely
Throwing away the BM25 index and rebuilding it from scratch
Re-embedding the full 2M-LOC corpus on each commit
Re-embedding only chunks whose text changed and recomputing affected symbol edges

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：只重embed变化块并更新受影响edge；还处理删除重命名/事件乱序/generation原子切换，60s需实测。

source.question: Which metric measures whether retrieved claims are verifiable in the source?
options: Citation faithfulness
p95 query latency
nDCG@10
MRR@10

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）：faithfulness检验主张与source support，MRR/nDCG是排行；链接可打开但不支持主张不能计成功。

knowledge: 代码检索先保留repo、commit、path、语言、符号身份、AST节点原文span与内容摘要。函数/类边界通常比硬切token易保存契约，但超长函数、文件级常量/配置、注释/测试、生成代码及解析失败需独立策略；AST非语义解析，跨语言RPC需协议/路由登记或可靠静态证据，不能凭模型猜import/call edges。嵌入可用摘要扩召回，引用仍回固定commit原文。

稠密检索解自然语言近义，BM25解精确符号/罕见ID，图扩大依赖候选，cross-encoder只重排已召回候选。RRF=sum 1/(c+rank)，不混原始score尺度；每列表先去重，跨列表同chunk投票。symbol重复不能直接去重：同名函数、重载/嵌套、不同commit要用明确chunk identity。字段重复改变tf和dl，是启发式加权而非完整BM25F。CamelCase/snake_case分词、中文查询与精确identifier通道须说明。

增量更新不是只add新块：删除/重命名要tombstone旧chunk；调用/导入邻居和摘要失效也要更新；embedding/preprocess版本改变不能混向量。Webhook去重、事件乱序、一次commit快照和active generation原子切换，确保dense/sparse/graph/原文一致，读者不会引用不存在或已无权限的span。query返回generation和commit，ACL在召回/重排/answer assembly/打开源证据逐层核。
引用格式通过只证明有anchor，需逐主张检查span确存在、当前主体能读、相应revision/行号、是否支持推论/否定/适用条件；有真实anchor仍可虚构语义。MRR看首次相关,nDCG看graded排行,多repo问题加证据集合Recall和完整答案支持率；100Q/2MLOC/50files<60s/10kQPS都是项目目标，非scaffold成绩或通用门槛。
code_flow: Python:6人工Chunk→DenseIndex.fake_embed与BM25Index.add→query两list→RRF以anchor归并→词项overlap stub rerank→打印anchor。没有tree-sitter、真实仓库walker、真实向量库/模型/graph/webhook/synth/citation verifier。hash(tok)受PYTHONHASHSEED随机化，称跨run deterministic错误；cosine仅点积且zip静默截维，成立需同dim且单位化。BM25空corpus/全空dl边界未严校，重复query term多计。

TS:corpus6条→FNV1a稳定hash embed/cosine/BM25→RRF→slice(topK)→Hono GET/POST查询。无rerank，README所谓hybrid API成立但不等完整code RAG；返回citations.score是RRF而非支持概率。GET默认top5/POST zod q非空topK1..50；候选始终最多dense10，非topK50真实召回。nodeAdapter全body缓冲无size/deadline/backpressure边界。测试只fixture排序/有引用/HTTP字段，不证明ACL/增量/grounding/scale。

source.question: Why does the 2026 frontier prefer vision-first late interaction over OCR-then-text on financial PDFs and scientific papers?
options: OCR pipelines mangle rotated tables, dense equations, and chart imagery, losing half the signal
OCR cannot run on GPUs
Vision models are cheaper per page
OCR is slower than rendering

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）方向：OCR可能破坏布局/表/图信号；去掉固定“损失一半”和视觉必胜断言。

source.question: What does late interaction mean in ColPali-style retrieval?
options: Each query token scores against every patch token, and per-token maxima are summed via MaxSim
Embeddings are computed after the user clicks a result
The reranker only runs on the final candidate
Embeddings are deferred until eval time

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）：每query token取document向量最大相似后求和，需mask/dim/encoder一致和空输入拒绝。

source.question: Roughly how many patch vectors does a ColQwen embedding produce per page, and what storage problem does that create?
options: Exactly 128 vectors, fitting cleanly in any vector DB
Around 2048 patch vectors per page, ballooning raw storage compared with single-vector indexes
1 vector per page, no storage issue
16 vectors with negligible storage overhead

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）为教材举例，patch数与分辨率/模型相关并非恒定2048，storage按实际shape dtype计算。

source.question: What does DocPruner do in this pipeline?
options: Removes duplicate PDF pages before ingestion
Compresses the multi-vector index by keeping high-signal patches at about 50% with negligible accuracy loss
Crops bounding boxes around evidence regions
Rewrites the query embedding for shorter vectors

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）为目标剪枝思想；教材程序仅L1 heuristic，无权宣称DocPruner准确率/50%压缩保证。

source.question: Why is an OCR text channel still spliced in for some pages?
options: VLMs cannot read images at 180 DPI
OCR is the primary retrieval modality
It improves PDF rendering quality
Equation-dense and table-heavy pages benefit from a text fallback alongside the image

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：OCR可补公式/表的结构化文本与精确回查，是否改善通过相同gold消融证明。

knowledge: 视觉文档检索将PDF每页渲染成图像，encoder保留每patch/token表示。MaxSim sum_i max_j q_i·p_j要求同encoder/processor/version/dim、有效mask、距离约定、finite且正确空输入处理，负分不能初始化0。多向量存储Np×d×bytes，例如10k页×2048×128×2=5,242,880,000B≈4.88GiB，仅向量，不含图像/索引/replica/metadata。patch数依模型/分辨率变化，不必每页2048。
检索与生成分两层：先retrieve相关page，再VLM读已授权page/query/OCR并逐claim引用docrevision/page/region；跨页问题需要全部证据页。MaxSim的高相似patch不证明答案定位、不能等同因果解释；evidence bbox需图页/原文支持验证。OCR对文本、公式、数表可保留结构通道，视觉可能优于OCR但不能称统一替代/丢半信号定律。

渲染要记录PDF原page size/crop/rotation/DPI、image actual widthheight与可逆transform。180DPI与1536×2048是不同约束，按页面尺寸渲染并保持比例再resize/pad需记映射。bbox约定(x,y,w,h)像素或normalized、pageNum1base、origin、clip、rotation/zoom/CSS与DPR；多页/不同尺寸不能混同单页canvas。加载实际图像并等待onload后overlay，错误加载有显式状态。

剪枝/池化/量化要分：随机/L1/variance删除只是启发式，不可包装DocPruner已证50%/小于.5%普遍准确率。剩patch为空、重要小数字被剪、dtype与index数据shape、候选阶段漏召回都纳入ablation。内容类别×approach同时测retrieval nDCG/集合recall、answer correctness、region support、storage/latency/fees，黄金问题与未知问题分开。
code_flow: Python:人工10pages词项→random.Random(hash(tok))16dim unit向量→sum(abs) L1排序keepfloor half→MaxSim→top3→with/without pruning overlap。没有PDF/OCR/视觉encoder/VLM/bbox/index服务/ViDoRe；跨process hash不稳，L1不是norm variance/真实DocPruner；maxsim空patch加-1e9、zip忽略维度、keep_fraction范围不核，不能复制生产。

TS:2写死fixture（Acme与Nature）→JSON或HTML→script canvas按0.5尺寸draw rectangle。pageImageUrl虽在payload却从未创建img/drawImage；/static无route，故只在空白stage画框，不是PDF证据viewer。Nature latency4.1x人工文本无论文结果，Acme为虚构非真实财报。HTML文本5字符escape，但JSON.stringify内联<script>未处理</script>，不可信evidence.text/URL可闭合脚本；getFixture返回普通Record原型属性（如__proto__）非own key。tests仅html字符串/正面积/范围score与route，不证明image存在、box定位、XSS或actual evidence。

exercises.source: Run the pipeline against three different seed ideas in the same domain. Compare which parts of the tree-search overlap. Identify duplicated wasted compute.
exercises.answer: 三seed固定同域/数据/评估版本，用config/artifact/inputdigest查重复节点和共享可复用基线；只有完全合同相同且旧结果有效才reuse，不因hypothesis文字似同就跳过。

exercises.source: Add a human-in-the-loop gate before experiment execution for nodes estimated above $5. Measure how much total cost drops.
exercises.answer: 成本>$5 gate为项目policy非通用法律；pre-run reservation/actor/task/args/code/env/time绑定review，拒绝/过期/改code要hold；记所有spent/unknown，不能假定人工gate必降真实费用。

exercises.source: Swap the reviewer ensemble for a single judge. Measure the false-accept rate on a held-out set of known-bad papers.
exercises.answer: known-bad heldoutpapers先固定真值与严重缺陷，single vs ensemble独立盲评分，测falseaccept/false reject/校准/成本/相关性，mean4/5非NeurIPS统一门槛。

exercises.source: Introduce a network-exfiltration red team test: agent writes code that tries to `curl` an external address. Confirm the `--network=none` policy blocks it. Log the attempt.
exercises.answer: 在专用安全测试环境检查实际网络拒绝/日志/停止；本轮不运行curl或恶意sourcecode。--network none仅隔离相应网络，另核mount/socket/privilege/creds泄露，不称“所有sandbox escape已阻断”。

exercises.source: Compare your tree-search with a flat random baseline (same budget, no expansion strategy). Report the novelty × quality gain.
exercises.answer: 同总budget/compute/任务/seeds/评价器，搜索开发集后freeze候选，在独立final集看quality/novelty证据与消融；random baseline不是故意给更少nodes。报告费用完整、失败和置信区间，不预定tree胜。

source.question: What search shape does the AI-Scientist-class agent use to explore experiments?
options: Breadth-first expansion with random scoring
Beam search over token outputs
Pure reinforcement learning from human feedback
Best-first tree search over experiment nodes with a novelty x quality x budget score

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）为课程设计方向；不是AI-Scientist全家唯一搜索，自己的heap不等AB-MCTS，教材×与实际sum分开。

source.question: Why is the sandbox configured with --network=none and bounded resource caps?
options: To force the agent to use prompt caching
To prevent network egress and contain experiment side effects within a reproducible envelope
To enforce deterministic floating-point arithmetic
To allow GPU passthrough by default

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）：网络和resource隔离缩小side effects，不保证浮点确定或所有escape安全。

source.question: What is the role of the vision critique step in the writer loop?
options: Generates new experiment ideas from screenshots
Replaces matplotlib at render time
Translates figures into bar charts
Compiles the LaTeX draft to PDF, then has a VLM critique layout, figure legibility, and claim-evidence alignment

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：render后查布局/图示/claim evidence，VLM评价仍可错不能替原数据核。

source.question: How does the reviewer ensemble gate the pipeline?
options: Reviewers vote anonymously and the majority wins
Five judges score on NeurIPS-style rubrics and the weighted aggregate must clear a threshold, otherwise the draft loops back to the writer
A single judge accepts or rejects on a binary flag
Reviews run after publication only

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）：aggregated reviewers可作候选gate，独立falseaccept评估与human review仍需，五judge/4分是自设。

source.question: Which cost discipline does the capstone enforce per paper?
options: GPU-hours tracked but never capped
A $30 hard budget tracked through Langfuse counters and pre-run estimates
Cost-only optimization without quality checks
Unbounded compute, hard wall-clock only

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）是题设$30，实际code仅后计费用不hard reserve；生产需全pipeline账本和unknowncost。

source.question: Which scoring function ranks tree nodes for further expansion?
options: Citation count of related papers
Random uniform priority
Output length and token count
Novelty x quality x remaining budget

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）仅指标维度；实际code=.4N+.5Q+.1B，source给乘积不符，B共同项不影响同期rank。

source.question: What does the red-team report exercise against the system?
options: Sandbox-escape attempts such as fork bombs, network exfiltration, and filesystem escapes
Caching hit rate on system prompts
Multi-tenant data leakage in the vector DB
Latency tail under packet loss

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）：redteam目标文件/网络/进程边界；测试通过只代表选案例/环境，不证明万能防护。

knowledge: 科研Agent拆成任务定义、相关文献证据、候选hypothesis/config/code、独立执行、验证记录、候选选择、写作/图表、复核。每node保留parent/artifact digest/dataset split/环境/seed/实际费用/结果及失败。文学检索50most-cited不是全面查新：补recent、negative、相关任务和原始方法，引用必须确存在且支持具体主张；相似度novelty不是新颖性证明。

best-first按候选优先级取frontier；明确分值来自预测还是已观测，未执行质量未知，不许默认为好或伪造成loss。score=.4novelty+.5quality+.1budget为加权和，教材×和AB-MCTS不等同此自定义heap。剩余预算共同常数不改变同时间候选排名，若想cost-aware可用每候选预估成本/价值但应受硬门禁。只改一变量利于ablation而非证明消除所有混杂。
预算账本先reserve上界再启动，settle实际spent或unknown pending，对writer/reviewer/API/失败/retry/compute全部记成本；账后警告不是hard cap。生成数/执行数/深度/并发/timeout/改写次数分别限制，去重config避免同操作重复搜索；unknown费用不释放保留额重试。失败不从账本或评价分母消失。

实验sandbox要实际隔离网络/文件/凭据/进程/CPU/mem/PIDs/walltime，容器只读root不自动限制挂载输出/特权/宿主socket；command以参数数组不要shell拼接。结果是非可信输入，校验schema/finite/units/split/no test exposure/日志真实。固定seed不等所有GPU bitwise相同。新发表/自动review成绩不替代独立证据，render critique能发现布局不能认证统计因果；多judge相关错误与false acceptance需gold已知坏论文测试。
code_flow: Python:root q=.5novelty1未实际实验→pop root→expand5children(q0,novelty.5)→push用执行前score与commonbudget→FIFO tie counter→pop才random fake实验→verify只failure或loss>4→cost累加→成功再expand→best_branch在done取maxquality。无LLM/lit/sandbox/train/writer/peerreview/redteam；loss和novelty均人造。说明声称best-first/maxdepth但未执行候选priors完全一样且无depth字段，数据流不是用observed quality筛好分支。
max_nodes是nodes字典生成数且batch5可由21变26，非已探索24；pop之前generation门禁可让许多生成候选永不执行。spent>=budget在开始前但未reserve下次cost可超出；actual code scoring加权sum不是乘积；同config多parents重复未dedup。rng固定只证明模拟重放；loss<=4不证明下降/基线/单因素。
lessons.static: 静SVG experiment tree/budget/容器限制/writer/vision/review；score行是weighted sum，与文档乘积不符；parentbranch为示例，不代表源码树实际跑出。figure ce-experiment-tree动态root另核。
new_cpu_suggestions: 标准库预算reserve/settle/unknown/failedcost、不重复config与生成数/执行数/depth gate；不任意eval/子进程/Docker。
lessons.readme_disposition: 无TS README；不把outputs skill当授权或安装。

exercises.source: Build a second corpus slice under a different jurisdiction (e.g., HIPAA alongside GDPR). Demonstrate role+jurisdiction filtering preventing cross-leak on a 20-question cross-jurisdiction probe.
exercises.answer: 测试principal/tenant/role/region/effective version组合以及user spoof、index ACL撤销、citation open、cache与memory跨scope；20probe只case覆盖，禁把jurisdiction boost叫阻断。

exercises.source: Measure prompt-cache hit rate over a week of production traffic. Identify which queries break the cache prefix. Restructure.
exercises.answer: provider usage cached/write tokens+stage receipts与prefix实际序列、context排序、TTL和模型revision复盘；先区分application全prefixSHA命中与providerpartialprefix，不以demo重复一次当一周流量。

exercises.source: Add multi-turn memory with a 10k-token summary buffer. Measure whether faithfulness drops as the conversation grows.
exercises.answer: 固定turn与gold，在短/长/摘要/无摘要分别测指代/旧证据/错误事实传播/权限撤销；10k-token不是万能memory预算，history不能越权回灌或与当前事实混。

exercises.source: Swap Claude Sonnet 4.7 for Llama 3.3 70B self-hosted. Measure $/query and faithfulness delta.
exercises.answer: 同检索、guardrail与gold，全部stage费用/推理hardware并发利用率/quality/latency记录，不能用厂商token单价与自建满利用率直接比较。

exercises.source: Add an "unsure" mode: if top reranked scores are below a threshold, the agent says "I do not have confident citations" instead of answering. Measure false-confidence reduction.
exercises.answer: 校准任务专用拒答阈值，测answerable被拒与unanswerable被答、逐claim真实support；rerank低/高分不直接是概率，empty/0overlap/源冲突应单列。

source.question: Why does prompt caching matter so much in a regulated-domain RAG chatbot?
options: It eliminates hallucinations
At 60-80% hit rate it cuts per-query cost 3-5x by discounting stable prefix tokens
It removes the need for a vector database
It improves recall on the rerank stage

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）有条件成本方向，去掉60-80%hit必3-5x；output/未cache动态/各stage费可限制节省。

source.question: What goes into the cache header versus the uncached suffix of each request?
options: Random text padding to hit cache size
Only the retrieved documents
User question first, system prompt last
System prompt and static policies in the cache header, reranked context as cache extension, user question as the uncached suffix

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：稳定system/policy前缀、动态context扩展与user尾；写入/最小tokens/TTL/model合同仍必核。

source.question: How does the retrieval layer respect jurisdiction tags like GDPR or HIPAA?
options: It rewrites the user question per region
It blocks the response after generation only
It runs a separate index per country
Role and jurisdiction filters apply before the hybrid search merge so chunks outside the user's scope are never reranked

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）是正确目标，原TS只boost违规；role/jurisdiction自己报不授权，所有通道scope核。

source.question: Which layered guardrail combination does the synthesis stage pass output through?
options: Just an output PII regex
Only Llama Guard 4 on input
Llama Guard 4, NeMo Guardrails policy rails, and Presidio PII scrub, plus citation enforcement
A single LLM-judge faithfulness check

quiz.reference_answer: 选3（index2）是目标多层组合，sourcecode没真模型工具；权限是硬约束，regex/judge不替ACL。

source.question: What does the drift dashboard alert on?
options: A change in the underlying LLM provider
Latency above 200ms
A retrieval-quality drop, for example a 5% week-over-week dip in nDCG or citation score
Any new document added to the index

quiz.reference_answer: 选3（index2）为例阈值，需gold或标注样本才能估nDCG，变query mix和index更新延迟分别核。

source.question: How big is the golden set used to gate the deliverable's correctness rubric?
options: 200 expert-labeled question/answer pairs with citations
5 demo queries
2000 synthetic questions
20 questions

quiz.reference_answer: 选1（index0）题设200，规模应覆盖域问题/无答案/冲突/越权，非生产充分证据数。

source.question: Which RAGAS scores are tracked online per turn?
options: BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR
Token count and dollar cost
Faithfulness, answer relevance, and context precision
Throughput, GPU utilization, and queue depth

quiz.reference_answer: 选3（index2）题设faithfulness/relevance/contextprecision；记录版本/metricdefinition/judge成本误差，不当自动合规或最终truth。

knowledge: 受监管RAG先鉴别真实主体和tenant/objectACL，再确定数据目的/地区/版本有效期；GDPR/HIPAA/SOC2是不同适用框架非互斥地理标签。标签不使系统合规，role等从server认证上下文，不能请求query参数自封counsel。vector/BM25/graph/context/summary/引用UI及缓存都按当前权限；排名boost不能过滤，先召回全库后过滤既可泄密又漏授权集合中低排名答案。

答案是否可靠由retrieval coverage/revision freshness、事实正确、citation support、privacy/safety分别检查。200gold/50redteam/5%下降是可改任务标准，测试集被改prompt/retriever反复利用会变开发集需独立final。RAGAS judge faithfulness是代理证据，source错误但答案忠于source仍不是事实正确；无gold weekly nDCG无法从纯未标注日志自动得到。低rerankscore阈值要领域校准/拒答正确性，不共用不同模型原分数。

缓存要分provider prefix与应用answer cache。稳定system/policy有助重复prefix，query相关context只是该cache extension可复用，不能固定hit rate/总费3-5x。总价含miss输入/output/retrieval/embedding/rerank/guard/cache write、失败；已有服务03维护真实cache write/TTL/retention/version。缓存scope绑定tenant/principal/permission epoch/model/revision/安全policy；hit不免再次授权。SHA256截64bit教学key不安全授权，不保证TTLs/provider真的读中。

多轮history存储不等参与检索或answer；summary为派生无权升级旧幻觉。sessionID由服务签发或ownership绑定，token revoke后memory需重新scope；请求重放以turnID/inputdigest幂等防duplicate。流式token已给用户后不能靠final guard收回信息，机密输出必须release前按完整span检查或可信已审核内容流，partial,error,done,disconnect分别记状态/费用，不把半答记成功。
code_flow: Python:5虚构Chunk role/juris exact+public/any过滤→Jaccard dense与词重叠/length pseudo BM25→RRF把全部eligible连0分也排名→system/policy/contextSHA截16hex→PromptCache store计数→拼接text60chars答案/3正则input/2regex scrub。无trueLLM/cacheAPI/rerank/presidio/LlamaGuard/NeMo/metrics/state；irrelevantquery也获得eligible citations；英文字面regex不能宣称高强防注入。MSA/GDPR30d与HIPAA60d是虚构合同fixtures非法律通用时限。

TS:KB4条→querytoken overlap>0+jurisdiction match2 boost→top3→SSE session/citations/token/done；没有role filter/真实ACL，HIPAA文档可出现在GDPRresponse。client任意sessionId/role/jurisdiction；SessionStore既有记录角色被ignore但本次retrieval仍按新requesttag，/sessions无auth暴露所有sessionmetadata。history保存但query不用；demo固定demo-session所有人共享。GETq把敏感问题写URL/history/proxylog；EventSource default可重连重复turn，没eventID/turn幂等/heartbeat/真正streambackpressure/proxy验证。splitwhitespace tokens是UI片段不是模型计费token；parseSseStream LF简版不完整WHATWG。
lessons.static: 静SVG显示role先filter的正确目标，但TS只boost，正文figure key canary-rollout与asset rag-stack不一致；root按实际注册动态另核。60-80%/3-5x无实测不变成结果。
new_cpu_suggestions: tenant-bound conversation turn ledger with replay/conflictingbody/ownership/permissionepoch/cachehit recheck + rejectirrelevant evidence；不启动SSE/HTTP。

exercises.source: Change the published remote URL while leaving the live server unchanged. Make the registry validation report the exact drift.
exercises.answer: pinpublication URL+身份/version/完整descriptor，重新真正probe目标并验证channel provenance；Python目前runtime_alignment只name/version，remote变化并不会验证真实漂移，需独立admission collector而非修改模拟url就成功。

exercises.source: Send `tools/list` twice with identical inputs and prove byte-stable tool order. Then expire `ttlMs` and refresh.

source.question: Why does this capstone use both server.json and server/discover?
options: server.json stores sessions, while server/discover deletes them
The Registry requires both files to contain identical version dates
They are two names for the same tool manifest
server.json publishes install and endpoint metadata, while server/discover reports live protocol capabilities
source.explanation: The Registry record helps clients locate and configure a server. The live RPC reports what the running process supports. Their schemas and version domains are independent, but the published identity must use the authenticated namespace and match live serverInfo.

source.question: What replaces the initialize handshake in MCP revision 2026-07-28?

Every request carries protocol version and client capabilities, and clients can call mandatory server/discover
A GET request that opens a permanent server stream
A session cookie sent once per TCP connection
source.explanation: The protocol is stateless. Version and capabilities are request metadata, while server/discover provides live version and capability discovery without creating a session.

source.question: Which tools/list behavior supports safe and efficient discovery?

A random tool order on each replica
A connection-local list created during initialize

source.explanation: Stable ordering improves reproducibility and prompt caching. ttlMs communicates freshness, and cacheScope prevents user-specific results from leaking through shared caches.

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：deterministic order+TTL+scope；privatevisibility勿publicreuse，stale反应要status/pin核。

source.question: Which Streamable HTTP design matches the current stateless transport?

A standalone GET stream uses Last-Event-ID replay
Each JSON-RPC message uses its own POST, with JSON or request-scoped SSE for a request
source.explanation: Current Streamable HTTP is POST-only for MCP messages and has no protocol session, standalone GET stream, session DELETE, or Last-Event-ID resumability.

quiz.reference_answer: 选4（index3）：每JSONRPC新POST回应JSON/requestSSE；accepted notification202 no body，SSE关闭取消，不自动durabletaskcancel。

source.question: What must a production server validate before a policy-approved tool handler runs?

source.question: Which evidence best supports the claim that the server scales without protocol sessions?

A wire-level concurrent run across two interchangeable replicas with no affinity dependency
A unit test that constructs one response dictionary
A diagram showing a load balancer

quiz.reference_answer: 选2（index1）：真实双replicas并发wire且无affinity依赖；dict tests、目录entry、diagram都不是部署证据。

knowledge: 学习助手先拆学生潜在技能、题目观测、教学动作和复习时间。BKT四参数p_init、p_learn、p_slip（已知仍错）、p_guess（未知猜对）；correct后posterior=p(1-slip)/[p(1-slip)+(1-p)guess]，wrong后=p slip/[p slip+(1-p)(1-guess)]，再learntransition posterior+(1-posterior)learn。概率只表示模型belief非学生真实掌握；参数从合法历史fit并以student/time heldout校准，提示/重复/抄答案可影响观测且多skill题另建模型。

手算p=.2 slip=.1 guess=.15 learn=.12：correct posterior=.18/.30=.6→.648，wrong posterior=.02/.70≈.028571→.145143。分母零意味着观测在模型下不可能，应报告/按明确strategy更新，不能epsilon夹成假posterior。验证概率finite[0,1]和bool输入；只存correct不记录item/prompt/hint/inputrevision会丢观测条件。

curriculum prerequisites图先reject重复ID/unknown prereq/selfcycle/generalcycles、toposort稳定；选概念是eligible加教学优先，首次eligible不等全局lowestmastery。mastery阈值应有任务证据，reviewdue和newlesson预算平衡，不让持续新课饿死复习或score>.95永不复习。BKT代表掌握预测，FSRS代表随时间记忆/遗忘，DSR states/ratings/parameterfit/desired retention不等double/half interval。Socratic可提示逐步，但死守永不讲解会让卡住学生耗损，适时明确教学/工作示例/诊断。

learnerID必须来自认证owner，memory、voiceclip、OCRphoto、summary、parent dashboard按scope/purpose；学生自己发correct:true不是评估证据。photo辨识误差先核方程/units，ASR错口误不能直接降mastery，教学安全也不能把寻求帮助都block。COPPA适用特定under13service与数据，不给固定一年保留许可；purpose-limited retention/parent rights/consent核真实政策，报告只是进步假设非诊断。

真实学习效果需预注册主指标、同等内容/接触时间baseline、合理分配、可靠pre/post/迁移/延迟保持测验、CI/缺失/退出/实际usage；10+10两周只是探索pilot规模，随机模拟或模型masterysum不能代替人类gain。控制组可线性samecontent与adaptive做对照，random concept order也改先修条件/顺序，不能单归因learner model。
